class.name: GameplayTagQuery
class.brief_description: Declarative all/any/none test over a [GameplayTagContainer] or [GameplayTagStackContainer].
class.description: A container matches when every tag in [member all_tags] matches, at least [member min_any_matches] distinct query tags in [member any_tags] match (ignored when empty) and no tag in [member none_tags] matches. Hierarchy matching follows [member exact]. Use [method matches_stacks] to apply the same query against counted tags: each matching tag must meet [member min_stack_count]. For a parent tag, the count includes all matching descendants. [method matches] ignores the stack threshold. [method matches_stacks] ignores [member min_any_matches] and applies only [member min_stack_count].

method.name: matches
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param container] satisfies the query. A [code]null[/code] container is treated as empty.

method.name: matches_stacks
method.description: Evaluates all/any/none against stack counts at least [member min_stack_count]. A [code]null[/code] container behaves like an empty one. A query with no requirements succeeds. Exact matching and parent hierarchy are controlled by [member exact].

members.member: At least one of these must match, unless empty.
If [code]true[/code], parent tags are not matched.

How many distinct [member any_tags] entries must match, from 1 to 64. Duplicates in the query do not raise this count. Invalid values leave the previous threshold unchanged; with an empty [member any_tags] array the threshold is ignored.
Minimum positive count per requested tag in [method matches_stacks]. Range is 1 to 65535. A parent tag uses the total of its descendants; the property does not affect boolean [method matches].
